Question
========
The core principles of German society named by The German Federal Government’s Data Ethics Commission emphasize which of the following approaches to digital technologies?

Answerlist
----------
* Market-driven innovation
* Human-centeredness
* Profit maximization
* Full automation of data processing


Solution
========
The principles emphasize a human-centered approach to digital technologies.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
